description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
That sounds lovely — glad you had a relaxing trip with Maria. Would you like me to do anything with that (draft or send an email about it, save a note, forward photos, etc.)? Here are a few quick options I can help with — tell me which one you want:

- Draft a short thank-you/recap message to Maria
- Draft a longer update to friends or family with highlights and photos
- Create a social-style message you can copy/paste
- Save a draft or note summarizing the trip
- Anything else (e.g., send photos, reply to an email about your trip)

If you'd like a start, here’s a short sample email to Maria you can send or edit:

Subject: Weekend in the countryside — thanks!

Hi Maria,

I had such a lovely time this weekend — the nature trails were beautiful and the fresh air was exactly what I needed. My favorite part was [insert favorite moment]. Thank you for coming along — it was great to relax and explore together. I’ll share the photos soon!

Love,
[Your name]

Tell me which option you want and any details to include (favorite moment, specific photos to mention, tone), and I’ll draft or send it.

steps.description: Start new session to test memory recall - memory was built in previous session

steps.user_message: What did I do during the weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should recall from memory: Exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:

Would you like me to draft that message to Maria or help organize/share the photos?
